# Fenza Facade Engineering

> Fenza Facade Engineering is a dedicated building-envelope manufacturer in Gurugram, Haryana, India, producing curtain wall, structural glazing, aluminium windows and doors, cladding, louvers and architectural elements — engineered and fabricated on its own aluminium line.

Fenza is a separate legal entity within the Hagerstone group, focused exclusively on facades. Its registrations and certifications are held in its own name. Technical values published by Fenza are indicative until confirmed per project against the approved system and the facade consultant's specification. Project experience attributed to Akhilesh Kumar Singh (Director — Facade Projects) is his own career record; Fenza's own project portfolio is being built.

## Facade system families
- [Curtain Wall](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/curtain-wall): Aluminium mullion-and-transom curtain walling, fabricated on our end-milling line so transoms seat square against mullions and the joint stays watertight.
- [Structural Glazing](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/structural-glazing): Flush glazed facades where the glass is bonded to a concealed aluminium carrier frame, leaving only a fine silicone joint on the outside.
- [Spider & Point-Fixed Glazing](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/spider-glazing): Point-supported glazing for atria, lobbies and entrance screens, where the glass is carried on stainless routels rather than a frame.
- [Casement Windows](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/casement-windows): Side-hung, top-hung and fixed aluminium windows built the traditional way — profiles cut to a 45° mitre, hardware prepped on the copy router, and corners mechanically crimped for a tight, square joint that does not rely on welding.
- [Sliding Windows & Doors](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/sliding-windows-doors): Two, three and four-track sliding systems on butt-jointed, end-milled frames.
- [Slide & Fold Doors](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/slide-and-fold-doors): Multi-panel folding doors that stack clear of the opening, for terraces, balconies and openable frontages.
- [Frameless Glass Doors](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/frameless-glass-doors): Patch-fitted toughened glass doors for lobbies and entrances, running on floor springs with stainless patch fittings top and bottom.
- [Metal & Composite Cladding](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/cladding): Cassette and tray cladding carried on an aluminium sub-frame fabricated on our line.
- [Rain-Screen Ventilated Facade](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/rain-screen-facade): A drained and back-ventilated outer skin on a thermally isolated carrier system, with the cavity left open so moisture and heat can escape behind the panel.
- [Louvers & Sun-Shading Fins](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/louvers): Extruded aluminium blades for solar shading, plant screening and facade articulation.
- [Railings & Balustrades](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/railings): Structural glass balustrades on extruded base-shoe channel, and aluminium post-and-rail systems, for balconies, terraces, stairs and edge protection.
- [Skylights & Canopies](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/skylights): Overhead glazing and entrance canopies on thermally isolated aluminium rafter-and-purlin framing, with internal gutters and condensation channels designed into the section.
- [Pergolas](https://fenzafacade.com/systems/pergolas): Aluminium pergola structures with fixed or adjustable aerofoil blades, drained through the frame so rainwater runs down concealed gutter posts rather than off the edge.

## Company
- [Systems overview](https://fenzafacade.com/systems): All thirteen facade system families across curtain wall, glazing, fenestration, cladding, solar control and architectural elements, with a full system index (codes FZ-CW to FZ-PG, variants and typical data).
- [Sectors](https://fenzafacade.com/sectors): The eight building types the Fenza system range serves — commercial towers, corporate offices and IT parks, residential high-rise, hospitality and serviced apartments, retail and mixed-use, institutional and healthcare, aviation and public infrastructure, industrial and factory.
- [Project record](https://fenzafacade.com/projects): Ten facade and envelope developments led by Akhilesh Kumar Singh — DLF Building 8 and DLF WeWork (Cyber City), Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (Hyderabad), Max Hospital (Saket), Krisumi Waterfall Residences, Adani Samsara Vilasa, M3M, Broadway Service Apartment, Anygraphics Factory and Dee Development. IMPORTANT: this is his own career record, NOT Fenza Facade Engineering's completed projects; Fenza is newly established and its own portfolio is being built.
- [Manufacturing](https://fenzafacade.com/manufacturing): The Gurugram aluminium line — double-head cutting to ±0.1 mm, copy routing, corner crimping, end-milling, the two construction methods (mitred-and-crimped, butt-jointed notch-and-tenon), finishes and reference standards (IS 1948, ASTM E283/E330/E331, EN 12207/12208/12210).
- [Quality & Safety](https://fenzafacade.com/quality-safety): In-process checks, batch verification, machine condition monitoring and sign-off before despatch; site safety planned before work begins, covering work at height, PPE, lifting, welfare and emergency preparedness. Installation is by Fenza's own site teams.
- [Leadership & Projects](https://fenzafacade.com/leadership): Akhilesh Kumar Singh, Director — Facade Projects, 25+ years in facade engineering, structural glazing, cladding and high-rise execution.
- [About Fenza](https://fenzafacade.com/about): A facade-only manufacturer; the Hagerstone-group relationship stated as backing.
- [Resources](https://fenzafacade.com/resources): Product catalogue download; system datasheets and test reports in preparation.
- [Contact](https://fenzafacade.com/contact): Facade enquiries and RFQs. Manufacturing in Gurugram, Haryana.

## Notes
- Fenza manufactures the building envelope only; it does not undertake interiors, fit-out, MEP, PEB or civil work.
- Contact details (email, phone, precise factory address) are being confirmed and are not yet published.
